assumptions.statement: Repository provisional rough site and key-area geometry is used only for concept topology and display; official_boundary=false remains authoritative.
assumptions.impact: Every area-sensitive layer and metric has low confidence and cannot support redline, parcel, acquisition or approval claims.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official site and key-area polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Official FAR, height, density, setback, facility and road-redline controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Massing and programme drawings are reference envelopes only; statutory intensity metrics remain unknown.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory planning conditions are supplied.

assumptions.statement: No complete existing-building, condition, ownership or heritage survey is available.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints are conceptual urban-form prototypes; no building-specific demolition decision is made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Measured survey, title, structure, fire and heritage assessments are complete.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, traffic counts, station interfaces, bus operations and autonomous-vehicle permits are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Routes express walking, cycling, universal-access and service-separation needs, not engineering alignments.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Transport survey, safety assessment and authority coordination are complete.

assumptions.statement: Utility capacity, drainage, energy load, cooling, fire access and underground conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Edge nodes, heat pumps, storage, charging and rainwater systems remain concept components.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Utility and engineering due diligence is complete.

assumptions.statement: Heritage inventory, view corridors, old trees, green lines, blue lines and river controls are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Public-space and massing prototypes must move, shrink or stop if specialist controls conflict.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Heritage, arboricultural and ecological surveys are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Technology bands R1-R4 describe proposal maturity and bounded deployment, not certified TRLs or product readiness.
assumptions.impact: Experimental physical AI, world-model and spatial-computing uses stay inside simulation or supervised test environments until independent gates pass.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Named systems complete domain-specific testing, safety, cybersecurity, accessibility and legal review.

assumptions.statement: IMT-2030/6G is a long-term conduit, power, cooling and spectrum-coordination reserve only.
assumptions.impact: No 6G coverage, latency, deployment date or vendor is claimed.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Formal standards, spectrum policy, network plans and a justified use case are available.

assumptions.statement: Compute waste heat can be used only where temperature, simultaneity, distance, heat-pump performance, backup and lifecycle economics are viable.
assumptions.impact: The winter garden is a feasibility prototype, not a guaranteed energy outcome.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Hourly load, cooling-water, heat-demand, carbon and cost models pass independent review.

assumptions.statement: Six civic AI rights are proposal governance conditions and require legal, institutional and service-design adoption.
assumptions.impact: Any scenario lacking equivalent human service, appeal, minimum data or an effective stop remains ineligible for public pilot.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A named accountable body adopts, funds and audits the rights charter.

assumptions.statement: Events, alliances, budgets, recruitment, grants and procurement pathways are recommendations only.
assumptions.impact: No government, company, funder or community commitment is claimed.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Named parties adopt a governance charter, resource plan and RACI.

assumptions.statement: All seven generated images are synthetic atmosphere and system-intent visualizations.
assumptions.impact: They cannot prove existing conditions, precise spatial relationships, public opinion, accessibility performance or engineering feasibility.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Professional survey, design and stakeholder consultation produce verified drawings and records.
